description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}.
Repeat.
